src.description: The image, relative to the instance root. It carries NO text: the step title and any caption are translatable page text, rendered from the step's `title` and `alt`.

alt.description: What the picture shows: translatable page text, rendered beside the image as its caption, never baked into it.

prompt.description: The scene, as a prompt for an image generator, for when no picture exists yet. It asks for no readable text, signs or logos.

Illustration.description: A step's picture, or the brief for drawing it. A picture carries no text; the title and caption are page text.

title: IllustrationSchema
description: Generated from `IllustrationSchema` in schemas/process/user-scenario.ts, which is authoritative. Published because it is an exported Zod `*Schema` (owner ruling 2026-10-05) — which says it is reachable, not that it is stable.
